title: Benchmarking non-conformity score functions in conformal prediction
abstract: arXiv:2605.24983v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Conformal prediction is a useful and versatile alternative to model calibration in machine learning classification. It replaces single-class prediction with prediction sets, guaranteeing that the a priori probability of the prediction sets containing the true class is larger than or equal to a pre-specified rate. The size and usefulness of the prediction sets relies heavily on the choice of the non-conformity score function. The scientific literature contains many examples of non-conformity score functions but there is an absence of studies examining their properties and effectiveness. In this paper, we give an overview of properties of non-conformity score functions. We give examples of non-conformity score functions in the existing literature and introduce original modifications. translated_title: 保形预测中非保形评分函数的基准测试
translated_abstract: 保形预测是机器学习分类中模型校准的一种有用且通用的替代方法。它用预测集替代单类预测，保证预测集包含真实类别的先验概率大于或等于预先指定的比率。预测集的大小和实用性在很大程度上取决于非保形评分函数的选择。科学文献中包含许多非保形评分函数的实例，但缺乏对其性质和有效性进行考察的研究。在本文中，我们概述了非保形评分函数的性质，给出了现有文献中非保形评分函数的实例，并引入了原创性的改进方法。我们提出了一种评估保形预测器预测集大小的原创方法，并利用该方法对不同非保形评分函数进行了比较。
tldr: 本文系统综述了保形预测中非保形评分函数的性质，提出了原创的评分函数改进及一种评估预测集大小的新方法，并对不同非保形评分函数进行了基准比较。
en_tdlr: This paper provides an overview of the properties of non-conformity score functions in conformal prediction, introduces original score function modifications and a novel method for evaluating prediction set sizes, and benchmarks the comparison between different non-conformity score functions.
